## About Korfball
- Mixed-gender sport: 4 male, 4 female per team
- No dribbling - emphasis on teamwork and passing
- Open to all ages and fitness levels
- Competing in {% for l in club.leagues %}{{ l }}{% unless forloop.last %} and {% endunless %}{% endfor %}
- Monthly social events including Payday Pub Day at The Tiny Rebel
